summary_en: Introduces a lightweight Siamese self-supervised framework that exploits complementary back-projection and Fourier-domain reconstructions to remove sparse-detection artifacts in photoacoustic computed tomography without paired artifact-free supervision. The method is evaluated on simulations, phantoms, in-vivo rat data, and human data.
